name: sql-adsi
author: Tw1sm
comment: Dump ADSI linked-server credentials and configuration

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Target SQL Server host, optionally host\instance. Use 'localhost' for the local server.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Initial database to connect to (empty = master)

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Linked server to route the query through (empty = none)

parameters.name: impersonate
parameters.description: SQL login to impersonate on the target server (empty = none)

parameters.name: adsi_server
parameters.description: Linked server that has ADSI configured (the ADSI link target)

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: TCP port opened on the SQL Server to receive the ADSI payload. Default: 4444
